name: photobooking-functions
description: Cloud Functions for photobooking: thin Firebase adapters around packages/domain.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:5001 JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-nag --only auth,firestore,functions "node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 'test/integration/**/*.test.ts'"
